current_activity: landing and joining the Koli Point airfield force
notes: Miller, ch. IX: the 18th Naval Construction Battalion landed on 12 December 1942. Chapter VII says that after the Aola force finished moving to Koli Point (the move was completed by 3 December), it was joined there by this battalion. The claim is the 12 December landing Miller names, at Koli Point, not a Company B first-day pin. Official Navy itineraries disagree on Company B (3 December versus 6 December); that disagreement is recorded and no 3 December claim is entered. Confidence 0.5: Miller only in this increment. Domain ground, branch Navy.
